implementation.name: Astrocade (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 49 HDL source files (4 systemverilog, 6 verilog, 39 vhdl) alongside 22 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 6 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 6 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 6 distinct machine_id rows. License: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file; the grant lives in the source header at https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-Astrocade_MiSTer/blob/master/Arcade-Astrocade.sv, which offers the work under the GNU General Public License "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 49 source files (4 systemverilog, 6 verilog, 39 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
